_what: Three ceilings over this repository's test code. Each may only fall. Enforced by scripts/check-test-budget.py at the pre-commit stage; a RAISE is refused by scripts/check-test-budget-raise.py at the commit-msg stage unless the message declares it.
_counted: Every .py file under tests/, not only test_*.py, so code moved into a helper module still counts.
_counted_lines: CODE lines only: blank lines, comment lines and docstrings are not counted, so explanation is never punished.
_history: Measurements and every declared raise: registry name engine-config-history in the data repository (test-budget.json), and git history.
